            "content": (
                "Summarize these moderation decisions for a human reviewer. "
                "Return a short paragraph and then 3-5 bullet points.\n\n"
                f"{user_content}"
            ),
        },
    ]


def summarize_moderation_decisions(decisions: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]], timeout: int = 30) -> str:
